name: agentic-rails
description: Agentic Rails marketplace: installable, lifecycle-managed verifiers and guardrails for agentic coding tools.

plugins.name: game-golden-screenshot-verifier
plugins.description: Runtime smoke verifier for games: launches the game, drives it into a deterministic state, captures a screenshot, and compares it against a versioned golden. Exit 0 pass / 1 fail.

plugins.name: wpf-visual-quality-gate
plugins.description: Evaluator-run visual quality gate for WPF desktop apps: an independent evaluator launches the app, drives the changed interaction with real input, and screenshot-verifies the result against explicit pass criteria.

plugins.name: jobs-done-guardrail
plugins.description: Deterministic Stop-hook guardrail: an agent finishing a turn with relevant code changes must pass the project's build and unit tests before handing back to the human. Fingerprint-skips already-validated states. Claude Code only.

plugins.name: advisor-guardrail
plugins.description: Actor-critic guardrail for Claude Code: executor sessions must consult a stronger read-only advisor subagent before their first write, enforced deterministically by a PreToolUse hook. Claude Code only.

plugins.name: codex-as-critic-guardrail
plugins.description: Cross-vendor actor-critic guardrail for Claude Code: executor sessions must consult an antagonistic, read-only GPT-5.6-Sol critic (via the local Codex CLI) before their first write, enforced deterministically by a PreToolUse hook. Claude Code only.

plugins.name: python-uv-guardrail
plugins.description: Deterministic PreToolUse guardrail: any Bash command that invokes python/pip directly instead of through uv is denied with a retry instruction, keeping Python work inside isolated, uv-managed environments. Pure pattern match. Claude Code only.

plugins.name: readme-name-guardrail
plugins.description: Deterministic PreToolUse guardrail: denies creating a 'readme.md' (any capitalization) anywhere but the project root, and denies git add/commit of one, keeping the repository to a single unambiguous README instead of dozens of same-named files. Rename with a descriptive prefix. Pure pattern match. Claude Code only.
